report.clinical_summary: Patient presents with fatigue and worsening headaches, describing the illness as taking over their life and feeling like a constant weight. They have been on Triumeq for some time but struggle with adherence, sometimes skipping doses or taking breaks when feeling okay. They express worry about long-term harm from the medication and whether it will remain effective. They trust their doctors but feel confused about how HIV affects them day to day and worry about the future as they age.
